HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — TERMLY EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Establishment of colonial rule is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Establishment of colonial rule as rumours only.
   B. Explain Establishment of colonial rule with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Establishment of colonial rule never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Establishment of colonial rule.

2. Which statement about Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence.
   B. Explain Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence as rumours only.

3. Which statement about African Civilisations up to 19th Century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   D. Say African Civilisations up to 19th Century never happens in Kenya.

5. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nairobi
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nakuru

6. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map

   D. Explain Linguistic groups in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Destroying road signs

9. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.
   B. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.

   C. Treat Public Participation as rumours only.
   D. Explain Public Participation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about Colonization of Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Colonization of Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Colonization of Africa as rumours only.

13. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Ignore prices in shops

14. Which statement about Introduction to History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Introduction to History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   B. Say Introduction to History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.

15. Which statement about Elections in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   B. Say Global Wars never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Global Wars.
   D. Treat Global Wars as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Global Wars and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain American Revolution and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain International organisations and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Modern slavery and servitude Page 15 of 75 xiii 3.4 Global governance 3.5 1st Ge and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
